### Triage Summary

When the clinic asks `"Which appointment would you like to move?"` of a patient who only came in to book, [`DriverHearing.__call__`](file:///work/clinicbench/hearing.py#L60-L61) extracts `"target_appt"` as a question. In [`PatientPolicy.answer`](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L115-L117), `self.true_values("target_appt")` returns `([], [])` because `self.t["target_appt"]` is `None`, yet `answer` still returns a `"prop"` part with `aff=[]` and [`PatientPolicy.respond`](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L462-L470) sets `act = "answer"`.

[`Voice._prop`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L112-L136) returns `""` whenever both `aff` and `exc` are empty, and [`Voice.say`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L189-L192) skips empty `_prop` results without falling back, producing an empty string `""`. The same empty-prop bug also occurs for any other proposition with empty `aff` and `exc` (such as `slot` or `doctor` on non-booking truths like `cancel_own` or `eligibility_question`), which explains why a fix targeting only `target_appt` would fix the visible case while leaving hidden cases broken.
